listing.name: Hull Restoration skill nerf
listing.summary: A small mod that changes part of the Hull Restoration skill that makes your ships always recoverable, because I find it a bit too safe, especially for the survival mode experience.
listing.aiSummary: Reduces the recovery chance provided by the Hull Restoration skill to make ship loss more consequential.

description:
A small mod that changes part of the Hull Restoration skill that makes your ships always recoverable, because I find it a bit too safe, especially for the survival mode experience.

Download (from proton drive)

Doesn't change anything else other than HullRestoration.RECOVERY_PROB, and should be compatible with everything, safe to add or remove whenever. I attached the ModPlugin.java that does this below.

For example if you lost 18 ships in battle:
in vanilla without skill ==> 10 recoverable, 8 recoverable with SP; vanilla with skill ==> all 18 recoverable without SP
this mod changes by how much hull restoration skill increases the recovery chance (editable in settings.json),
with default mod's settings ==> 14 ships recoverable, 4 recoverable with SP - somewhere between vanilla and vanilla+skill

please tell me if something's off!
